This repository holds the assets needed to run the web interfaces of our open-source products, such as [Teleport](https://github.com/gravitational/teleport) or [Gravity](https://github.com/gravitational/gravity).

The source for those assets is available in the [webapps repository](https://github.com/gravitational/webapps). Issues or requests should be filed in that repository too - this one only exists for distribution purposes and has little manual activity.

item.text: I found a related issue in the existing patch: each device gets a different challenge nonce, but the browser U2F API accepts one nonce for the full key list. I’ll make the devices share a nonce, then add a browser compatibility script that expands the list for both login and password change calls.

item.text:
Updated web U2F authentication so both login and password change flows pass all registered keys to the browser U2F API, with a fallback for legacy single-key responses. All device challenges now share the nonce required by that API.

The web test confirms the served page includes the adapter and a second registered key can complete login. All reviewer-listed Go tests passed; `git diff --check` passed. An interactive browser run was unavailable.
